answer: Here is one mechanism that works: score identities on graph independence, not headcount, because timber only stays cheap while a clique of fresh wallets answers only each other and its independence score collapses. Concretely, saffron is enforced in the ledger: Detection is retrospective: payouts for a flagged cluster are clawed back after the fact. Any garden approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
